what: A thin line crossing the cell at −29.36° makes one full turn (362°) on hover over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.3,1), disappearing over .3s after .4s. Over the same duration a background-color cover is peeled back clockwise by a conic mask starting at 240.94°, revealing the photo beneath. Ink text on the cover turns white. On release the line returns right away, rewinding, and the cover closes. On touch screens it turns on once the cell’s bottom edge rises above 65% of the screen.

options.line: Line that switches on for touch screens (share of screen height), default .65
options.--fx-dur: CSS variable — length of one loop, default 1.4s
options.--fx-from: CSS variable — initial slope of the line, default −29.36deg (diagonal of a 16:9 cell)
options.--fx-start: CSS variable — the cone angle at which the cover starts to lift, default 240.94deg
options.--fx-cover: CSS variable — cover color, default background color
options.--fx-ink-on: CSS variable — text color after it turns on, default is the opposite stage text color

from.where: index.css .dz-mem__link (member 16:9 cell — original .member_link::before diagonal · .member_front::before conic-gradient mask, @property angle transition)

note: In browsers that can’t read @property the angle changes all at once. Diagonal length (115%) and angle are based on a 16:9 cell — for other ratios set --fx-from to that cell’s diagonal angle
